title: Imperial Reinforcements
caption: Imperial Reinforcements (V)
game_text: Once per game, if opponent has more cards with ability on table than you, draw destiny and retrieve up to that number of Imperials and/or Imperial starships (may take one retrieved card into hand). OR Cancel K’lor’slug.
lore: Imperial stormtroopers deploy in 8-10 trooper squads. Reinforcements are typically held in reserve according to standard Imperial operating procedures.

notes: Non-unique (no dot). Curly apostrophes in K’lor’slug. Lore matches the scan (hyphen in '8-10' as printed).
